name: Sióagárd (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with horizontal bands of green, white and green at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Sióagárd (a crowned blue shield with a yellow charge and a green mound) above a yellow scroll inscribed SIÓAGÁRD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sióagárd arms with crown and scroll
